Elaine (Sales): Heads-up — enterprise prospect (bank) asked about our on-prem POC upgrade cadence and offline activation flow. They have strict change windows and no outbound egress.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Key Qs we need: how small can the bundle be, do we support delta patches, and what activation model works with air-gapped sites?
Izzy (Security): Also need SBOM, signing, and assurance they can validate images with their internal CA. No external signature checks allowed unless they fetch certs locally.
Jordan (SRE): Short answers: we can do full image bundles and delta patching; signing supported via offline key exchange; activation via one-time tokens or signed license files. But need to map their maintenance window cadence to our patch cadence.
Elaine (Sales): They asked for concrete timelines: POC delivery, patching frequency, and how big a hotfix is (MBs/GBs). Can we give ranges?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Typical packaged POC image ~3.2GB compressed. Delta hotfixes usually <150MB for small runtime patches, up to ~600MB for model deltas depending on quantization. We can provide a delta pipeline that generates binary diffs between commits.
Izzy (Security): Will their compliance team accept rsync-style deltas or do they require re-signing each artifact? They usually want re-signed artifacts with their own CA.
Jordan (SRE): We support re-signing at their site. Our offline installer supports verifying local CA-signed manifests. Workflow we propose:
```
1) We produce artifacts + SBOM and sign with Redwood build-key (offline bundle)
2) Customer pulls artifacts into airgap VM via thumb drive or SAP-approved media
3) Customer runs local-sign tool to sign manifest with their CA
4) Installer validates signatures against local CA bundle and installs
```
Elaine (Sales): They also asked about activation: they can't call home. What options?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Two options:
- Offline activation token: we issue a time-limited token (CRT) that they import. Validated locally by checking signature and expiry.
- Customer-provided license file: they generate a CSR, we sign it and return license blob. Both work without outbound.
Izzy (Security): From Sec side, prefer CSR + signed license because no shared secrets shipped. We also need to provide HSM/KMS integration docs for when they move to production.
Elaine (Sales): Pricing question: customer wants POC pricing for 3 months and cost of offline support + airgap packaging. Any ballpark?
Devon (Solutions Eng): POC base: $12k for 3 months (includes 2 dev support hours/week). Airgap packaging + SBOM/signing kit: one-time $6k. If they want delta pipeline + custom signing tool integration add $8k. These are placeholders until AE approves.
Jordan (SRE): Note operational caveat: delta patching requires running our patch reconciler in an isolated orchestrator (we can ship a small container). It needs ephemeral compute to apply binary diffs; if their nodes are extremely locked-down we fallback to full-image replace. That increases transfer size.
Izzy (Security): Also checklist items they will require:
- Full SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX)
- Signed manifests with OIDC disabled by default
- Audit logs exported locally (we provide file-based and syslog exporters)
- Cert rotation playbook and key custody options (KMS/HSM)
- Pen-test window for the POC
Elaine (Sales): Can we generate a short runbook for them — install, offline activation, delta patch apply, rollback steps? They want it before the sales review tomorrow.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a 1-page runbook and attach sample commands. Example install snippet:
```
# import CA
sudo cp customer-root.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/
sudo update-ca-trust

# install bundle
sudo ./redwood-installer --bundle redwood-poc-2026.tar.gz --no-network

# apply delta
sudo ./redwood-updater --apply delta-0001.patch

# rollback
sudo ./redwood-updater --rollback v0.9.2
```
Jordan (SRE): Add note: run `sha256sum` on artifacts before and after transfer and compare to SBOM hash. Also run `pkg-bot verify` (pkg-bot will output signature validity).
pkg-bot: signature OK for redwood-poc-2026.tar.gz (sha256: a3f5...) :white_check_mark:
Izzy (Security): I need to review the license flow details and the HSM integration docs. Devon please include HSM key wrapping examples and an explanation of how private keys are never exfiltrated.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Will add HSM KMS section. Also will include fallback: if they cannot run our reconciler, we package nightly full-image deltas instead (compressed images).
Elaine (Sales): Great. Action items:
- Devon: draft runbook + HSM/KMS appendix + pricing breakdown (today EOD)
- Jordan: note in SRE runbook about hashes and reconciler resource needs
- Izzy: quick security checklist for AE to hand off to customer (EOD)
I'll bundle those in an email to the customer tomorrow AM.
Jordan (SRE): FYI — if they insist on monthly patch windows only, we should set expectation that small critical fixes can still be hotfixed via out-of-band signed delta but will require approval and scheduling.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll recommend a monthly scheduled cadence plus emergency patch SLA.
Izzy (Security): I'll flag any blockers once I review. If they require external attestation we'll need legal + engineering sign-off.
Elaine (Sales): Thanks all :thumbsup:
